content.short: Entre is a professional networking app to connect with web3 professionals.
content.description: Entre is a professional networking app designed for web3 professionals to connect, collaborate, and grow their networks. It features livestreaming and meeting hosting, as well as a job marketplace to uncover opportunities within the Web3 ecosystem. Users earn Entre Points by inviting new members, creating content, and completing tasks in the app. In the future, these Entre Points can be redeemed for prizes, cash, or cryptocurrency, offering ongoing incentives to engage and expand your professional network.
